name: cloud-libs
description: Ships every constellation library module as its own installable APK.
_doc: ab_cloud-libs-shared/keyboard-engines bundles five modules into ONE companion APK. This repo is the general case: one APK per library module, so each lib is installable, updatable and inspectable on its own. Nothing here names a module - the set comes from scanning lib_apks.scan, so a new module in aa_cloud-superapp/libs/ ships an APK with no edit to this file (FIRE RULE #6).

lib_apks._doc_scan: Every directory under ANY of these paths that contains a build.gradle is a library module and gets an APK. A list because ab_cloud-libs-shared/libs holds every SHARED module (consolidated there 2026-08-30 - it is the only multi-consumer root), while cal/contacts/maps/news/wallet are single-app feature modules that stayed in their own repos. Module names must be unique ACROSS roots - the name is both the gradle path and the applicationId suffix - and settings.gradle fails the build if two roots collide. Paths are relative to this repo's root.
lib_apks._doc_exclude: Modules that must NOT ship as a standalone APK, each with the reason. An exclusion is a claim about install-time behaviour, so it belongs in data next to the scan rule rather than as a silent skip in gradle.

exclude.usb-drive: #1375/#1405 USB-C drives (StorageVolumes, UsbVolumeModel, RawUsbDrive over libaums) compiled into Cloud Drive and the Store's Ventoy tab; no component, nothing to install or bind.
exclude.web-core: #1371 The fleet's one embedded web view factory (CloudWeb.create/configure, declared profiles), compiled into every app that shows web content; no component, nothing to install or bind.
exclude.cgc-3d: #1373 The CG apps' 3D viewer/editor: assets (cgc.js, three.js loaders, three-vrm) and pure Kotlin (declaration, scene ops, AvatarEngine, OpenRouter connector) compiled into CG-Omniverse; no component, nothing to install or bind.
exclude.sysdns: #741 The fleet's one bridge to Android's resolver for code that cannot use it directly (ResolverProxy for the gh, rclone and gix binaries; SystemDnsBridge for terminal shells). A plain library: no component, nothing to install, nothing an app binds. It is compiled into Cloud-Lib-Gh/-Rclone/-Gix here (settings.gradle includes it for them) and into cloud-drive, and the terminal forks compile its bridge source by reference.
exclude.decisions: #772 OpenRouter's Decisions API client (plain JVM Kotlin), compiled by Cloud Calc's Jev section and by Cloud-Lib-Ml-L-Image-Mlkit's OpenRouter route. No component, nothing to install, nothing an app binds: it rides inside the APKs that need it.
exclude.decisions-core: #881 The PIT harness of the decisions engine's logic: it compiles libs:decisions-engine's own core package as plain JVM Kotlin, runs its suite and mutation-tests it. No component, nothing to install; the logic itself lives in the engine's directory so the publish gate republishes the engine when it changes, and no app may compile this module.
exclude.decisions-link: #881 The CONTRACT half of the decisions engine: the IDecisionsEngine wire (no credential anywhere in it), the DecisionsLink client with its handshake and the typed Verdict. It has no component and installs nothing; the engine it binds ships as Cloud-Lib-Decisions-Engine.apk, which compiles this module in. Apps compile this one and never libs:decisions-engine.
exclude.ai-usage: #1499 The read of the fleet AI usage table (AiUsageClient + AiUsageModel, plain JVM Kotlin) compiled into the Cloud SuperApp and Cloud SuperIntel. No component, nothing to install or bind.
exclude.fleet-endpoints: #1093 THE fleet endpoint fallback (plain JVM Kotlin: the router that tries a service's mesh endpoint first and its public one with the fleet bearer second, the cached verdict, the bearer interceptors, the per-endpoint check), shared by reference between Cloud Mail (core:jmap) and Cloud Account (libs:account). No component, nothing to install, nothing an app binds: it rides inside the two APKs that link it, and its suite runs in both ship workflows and in this one.
exclude.fleet-endpoints-android: #1093 The Android halves of the fleet endpoint design (NetworkChangeWatch, the network-change signal the router re-probes on; FleetEndpointsClient, the pull of Cloud Account's published endpoint pairs). No component, nothing to install: it rides inside the APKs that link it (Cloud Account through libs:account, Cloud Mail), and Cloud Vault compiles its two files by reference.
exclude.fleetconfig-model: #825 The fleet-config manifest + migration policy (FleetPolicy, FleetPolicyEngine), split out of libs:core. No component, nothing to install: it rides inside Cloud-Lib-Fleetconfig (libs:fleetconfig, the engine every app's FleetConfigProvider binds) and the SuperApp, which plans the fleet with it.
exclude.databackend: #825 The generic engine wire (IDataBackend, DataBackendService, DataBackendClient), split out of libs:core. No component, nothing to install: it rides inside every engine APK that extends it and every app that binds one.
exclude.ml-l-sound: #798 The CONTRACT half of sound identification: the ISoundEngine wire, the client and sound.json that Cloud Calc and Cloud Camera compile. It has no component and installs nothing; the engine it binds ships as Cloud-Lib-Ml-L-Sound-Yamnet.apk, which compiles this module in.
exclude.disk: #813 The Disk Management engine is #763 `pinned`: it reads other apps' sizes under the usage-access grant and walks/deletes shared storage under the all-files grant of the app that compiles it (cloud-drive). A standalone APK would hold neither grant, so it would install a package that can read nothing.
exclude.disk-scan: #813 libs:disk's arithmetic, plain JVM and PIT-tested. No component, nothing to install: it rides inside cloud-drive through libs:disk.
exclude.git-ui: #1408 Cloud Drive's git manager UI. Nothing to install: compiled into cloud-drive.
exclude.git-repos: #1408 Cloud Drive's git repo model, plain JVM and PIT-tested. Nothing to install: compiled into cloud-drive.
exclude.git-core: #1408 THE in-process git engine (JGit), plain JVM and PIT-tested. No component, nothing to install: it rides inside cloud-drive through libs:git-sync.
exclude.sound-tags: #798 The arithmetic of sound identification (WAV decoding, resampling, the model's windows, averaging, the label list a model carries), plain JVM and PIT-tested. No component, nothing to install: it rides inside Cloud-Lib-Ml-L-Sound-Yamnet.apk, the only module that compiles it.
exclude.ml-l-image: The CONTRACT half of the image scan (engine-apk-split move 6): the IImageScanEngine wire, the typed payload and the client that Drive, Mail, Camera, Gallery and Office compile. It has no component and installs nothing; the engine it binds ships as Cloud-Lib-Ml-L-Image-Mlkit.apk, which compiles this module in.
exclude.cropper: Upstream image-cropper UI for cloud-gallery, moved into the shared root with the rest of its libs/. It was never a lib APK — gallery was not a scan root — and a standalone cropper APK installs nothing anyone can open. Excluded so the shipped set is exactly what it was before the merge.
exclude.gesture: Same: upstream gesture helper, compiled into cloud-gallery only.
exclude.panoramaviewer: Same: upstream panorama viewer, compiled into cloud-gallery only.
exclude.scrollbar: Same: upstream fast-scrollbar, compiled into cloud-gallery only.
exclude.keyboard: Already ships as its own APK (Cloud-Keyboard.apk, ac_cloud-keyboard). A second package carrying the same LatinIME service would register a duplicate input method, and its clipboard/gesture ContentProvider authorities come from string resources that both packages would claim - INSTALL_FAILED_CONFLICTING_PROVIDER.
exclude.autofill: The non-secret autofill SOT contract (a0_docs/eng-specs/autofill-3-tier.md): compiled in via project(':libs:autofill') by Cloud Account (which serves the provider), Cloud Browser and Cloud Keyboard. No component of its own to install -- ships no lib APK.
exclude.shared-store: cloud-shared-store static lib: compiled in via project(':libs:shared-store'), the store-access contract (ICloudExec client + path rules); not a runtime engine -- ships no lib APK.
exclude.cad-core: #1404 Hardtech-CAD's MCAD model-library core (manifest, format routing, cache, three.js viewer page): pure Kotlin + assets compiled in; no component, nothing to install or bind.
exclude.cad-mesh: #1404 Hardtech-CAD's glTF/GLB, OBJ, FBX viewer lib: assets only, compiled in; nothing to install.
exclude.cad-brep: #1404 Hardtech-CAD's STEP/IGES viewer lib (occt-import-js WASM): assets only, compiled in; nothing to install.
exclude.cad-dxf: #1404 Hardtech-CAD's DXF viewer lib (dxf-parser): assets only, compiled in; nothing to install.

exclude.cad-ifc: #1404 Hardtech-CAD's IFC viewer lib (web-ifc WASM): assets only, compiled in; nothing to install.

lib_apks._doc_static_libs: Section 2 of the Store Libs tab: one short description per shared lib that is NOT an engine (not installable). Which apps compile each lib in is never typed: 1_cicd/src/scripts/cloud-android-lib-consumers.py derives it from every app's build.json and regen.sh bakes it into constellation-fleet.json::lib_consumers. This map only says what the lib is; the lib-consumers guard fails when a non-engine lib has no entry here or an entry names a lib that is gone.

static_libs.apify: The fleet's one scraper backend choice and token store: Apify Cloud, self-hosted Cloudy Crawlee or Cloudflare Browser Run, shared by Cloud News, Media and Browser (#1470, #1474); no UI.
static_libs.usb-drive: USB-C drives: removable volumes and their size, the per-drive SAF grant, and raw USB mass storage through libaums (#1375, shared with the Store's Ventoy tab #1405).
static_libs.web-core: The fleet's one embedded web view: GPU-first WebView built by CloudWeb.create/configure with a declared profile per use (#1371).
static_libs.cgc-3d: The CG apps' 3D model viewer and editor: GLB/VRM/FBX in a WebView (three.js, three-vrm), clips, blendshapes, colour swaps, show/hide, GLB/PNG export, the avatar editor's declaration and its OpenRouter connector.
static_libs.account: The Account page: profile, sign-in lines, fleet cockpit, business card and QR gallery, plus the vault/git/SSH plumbing.
static_libs.account-ui: The profile pages Cloud Account and Cloud Me share: Personal Info (IDs, Pay Cards, Others, Autocomplete) and Configs (Android, Desktop, C3), declared once in account-ui.json (#1439).
static_libs.ai: The fleet's AI chat: page, streaming, Agent and Model pickers, sessions, consent card, assistant panel, gateway and OpenRouter backends, and the shared assets/ai/ai.json contract.
static_libs.analytics: Analytics client: consent flag, visitor id, bounded per-sink queue; the HTTP POST runs in the analytics-sink engine.
static_libs.appstore: The Constellation store: fleet list, install/update actions and the background fleet pass.
static_libs.auth: The fleet's one sign-in: Authelia bearer and web-auth, GitHub and Google device grants.
static_libs.autofill: Contract of the non-secret autofill Source of Truth: Cloud Account's profiles, site rules and snippets provider, its signature permissions and typed rows.
static_libs.battery: Battery and energy engine with its tiered energy model and dialogs.
static_libs.bluetooth: Android Bluetooth: LE scan with filters, connect, bond, GATT read / write / notify, known-service decoding from a declared UUID catalog, and the Bluetooth page, shared by the SuperApp, Cloud Calc and the Web Bluetooth bridge of Cloud Browser.
static_libs.nfc: The NFC tag analyzer: reader mode for NfcA / B / F / V, IsoDep, NDEF, NdefFormatable and MIFARE Ultralight page read, tag info, the NDEF parser (Text, URI, Smart Poster, MIME, External, AAR, Wi-Fi and Bluetooth handover) with hex / ASCII dump, NDEF write / format, scan history export, and the NFC page, used by Cloud Calc.
static_libs.perms: The permission contract: the catalogue of every runtime, special-access, app-op and adb-only grant, live status, exact settings pages, the ADB grant block and the deep link to the host's Permissions page.
static_libs.wifi: The Wi-Fi analyzer: scans within the throttle, AP list with vendor / security / standard / RTT / MLO, channel graph and rating per regulatory plan, the connected link, network tools (ping, traceroute, DNS, port scan, LAN discovery, throughput, RTT, locator), heatmap and exports, and the WiFi page, shared by the SuperApp and Cloud Calc.
static_libs.light: The Light tool: flashlight and screen light with strobe, timer and an Off-action service, as one Compose page shared by the SuperApp and Cloud Calc.
static_libs.bottomnav: The fleet's bottom navigation island, in Compose.
static_libs.theme-background: The fleet's shared page background and colour roles: Cloud Search's darker-gray palette, a subtle gradient, light and dark.
static_libs.ui-icons: The fleet's nav icon catalog: one table of semantic names to ImageVectors (tinted, or a brand icon drawn in its own colours), the single source of every nav-bar icon.
static_libs.ui-nav-bars: The shared navigation chrome of every app: first row (breadcrumb title, AI, Profile, Configs), second row (one row, two rows, vertical side menu with its rail), bottom nav, and the three-state scroll machine they follow.
static_libs.browser: In-app web browser: WebView host, per-tab persistence and the tab strip.
static_libs.ml-l-image-ocr: Cloud Writer's on-device text recognition (OCR) of an image into editable text (#1435).
static_libs.scraper: Cloud Browser's Scrapers section: Site Files (every file a site left, in-app viewer) and Scrap Tools (YouTube Download via scrappers-api).
static_libs.media-convert-audio: Audio track of a video remuxed on the phone (MediaExtractor/MediaMuxer), used by the YouTube tool.
static_libs.chat: Mattermost client: models, prefs, client and the chat pages.
static_libs.contacts: Contacts engine: device contacts, social import and the merge engine.
static_libs.core: Fleet base every app links: telemetry, notifications, log upload, fleet-config provider and the CONSTELLATION_DATA permission.
static_libs.crash: Crash-safe default every app gets through libs:core: the persist-first report, the phone's local C3 sink and the generic crash screen (stack trace, Copy, Share, Retry in safe mode).
static_libs.cropper: Image cropper UI for Cloud Gallery.
static_libs.databackend: The generic engine wire: IDataBackend, DataBackendService (what an engine extends) and DataBackendClient (what an app binds with).
static_libs.datamanager: Per-app usage and network metrics providers (UsageStatsManager, traffic).
static_libs.decisions: Client of OpenRouter's Decisions API, shared by Cloud Calc's Jev section and the image engine's OpenRouter route.
static_libs.decisions-core: PIT harness for the decisions engine's logic: compiles its core package as plain JVM Kotlin and mutation-tests it.
static_libs.decisions-link: Contract half of the decisions engine: IDecisionsEngine wire, handshake client and the typed Verdict.
static_libs.fleet-endpoints: The fleet endpoint fallback shared by Cloud Mail and Cloud Account: mesh first, then public with the fleet bearer, cached, re-probed on a network change.
static_libs.fleet-endpoints-android: Android halves of the fleet endpoint design: the network-change signal and the pull of Cloud Account's published endpoint pairs.
static_libs.devtools: Debug API, log pipe, fleet token and peer discovery that make an app a fleet mesh member.
static_libs.disk: Disk Management engine: volumes, storage map, huge files, duplicates, per-app sizes and cache clean.
static_libs.disk-scan: Plain-JVM arithmetic of disk management: tree walk, storage map, huge-file threshold, duplicate detection.
static_libs.git-ui: Git manager UI: repo table model, header, cells, repository menu, conflict solver and metadata table, the host's look lent through LocalGitUiKit.
static_libs.git-repos: Git repo model: repo scan, sync history and schedule, Auto Commit message core, auto checks, stale-pack cleaner.
static_libs.git-core: In-process git engine: JGit clone, fetch, pull --rebase, stash, push, conflicts and upstream on any storage root, with typed errors.
static_libs.file-editor: Full text editor: undo/redo, find/replace, line numbers, syntax colouring, encoding and line-ending aware.
static_libs.editor-core: The Editor's shell: browser-like tab strip over the opened files (persisted), an Obsidian-style View | Edit mode per tab, and the data-driven file-type router.
static_libs.json-viewer: JSON viewer: collapsible tree, syntax colour, search, copy path and value.
static_libs.log-export: Every app's log-export IPC door: an exported, signature-permission provider returning its recent logcat and crash ring as JSON, which Cloud-Webserver serves on the mesh as /logs/<app>.
static_libs.local-serve: Loopback-only local HTTP server (random port, traversal guard) and the WebView page for the Editor's Served mode.
static_libs.media-viewer: View-only image (zoom), audio and video over platform APIs.
static_libs.odf: OpenDocument odt, ods and odp: view and edit (zip plus platform XML DOM; odt through the WYSIWYG engine, ods as a table, odp as slides).
static_libs.pdf: PDF view (platform PdfRenderer) and edit (PdfBox-Android: ink, text and note annotations, form fill, page delete, reorder, rotate).
static_libs.wysiwyg: The shared WYSIWYG engine: block model with inline marks, Markdown and HTML codecs (round-trip), edit operations, Compose editor and viewer.
static_libs.fin: MyFin dashboard surface of the SuperApp.
static_libs.firewall: Clean-room no-root per-app outbound firewall over a local VpnService.
static_libs.fleetconfig-model: Fleet configuration manifest (fleet-config.json) parsed into stores, classes and apps, and its migration policy.
static_libs.gesture: Upstream gesture helper, compiled into Cloud Gallery.
static_libs.git-sync: Git manager: screen, repository registry, credential store and the client of the in-process engine (libs:git-core).
static_libs.gix: gitoxide as a fleet library: a sha256-pinned static gix binary that clones and fetches over HTTPS.
static_libs.health: Health Connect dashboard surface: store, metrics and pages.
static_libs.kde-connect: KDE Connect protocol plugins (share, SMS, telephony, SFTP, volume, virtual monitor).
static_libs.keyboard: Cloud Keyboard, the owned keyboard provider (LatinIME-derived input method service).
static_libs.launcher-apptabs: App Tabs: the last six opened sections, pages and external apps as a card grid.
static_libs.launcher-onehand: One-hand launcher controls: radial menus and swipe classifier.
static_libs.launcher-zoomies: Pet-strength view and bundled assets of the launcher.
static_libs.mail: Mail surface: host, message list and body fragments, pages.
static_libs.maps: GPS tracker, MapLibre Native renderer, SQLite stop store and MyTrips dashboards.
static_libs.media: Sticker and GIF panel for the keyboard's emoji surface.
static_libs.ml-l-image: Contract half of the image scan: IImageScanEngine wire, typed results and client; the engine runs in Cloud-Lib-Ml-L-Image-Mlkit.
static_libs.ml-l-sound: Contract half of sound identification: ISoundEngine wire and client; the engine runs in Cloud-Lib-Ml-L-Sound-Yamnet.
static_libs.ml-l-text-mlkit: ML Kit implementation of the translate engine client, bundled in Cloud-Keyboard-Libs.
static_libs.ml-l-voice-vosk: Vosk implementation of the voice engine client with model download, bundled in Cloud-Keyboard-Libs.
static_libs.model-catalogue: The fleet's model catalogue: the curated OpenRouter selection, its live pricing and the catalogue page; Cloud Search shows it all, Cloud Code's Chat its A0 Code section.
static_libs.mounts: Mounts screen, models, mount list, credential store and the client of the mounts engine, where ftp, sftp, ssh and webdav run.
static_libs.net: WireGuard contract: config and crypto parsing, Backend and Tunnel interfaces, statistics and the AIDL client.
static_libs.ops: Dagu page, bearer storage and the OpsLink client of the ops engine.
static_libs.panoramaviewer: Upstream panorama viewer, compiled into Cloud Gallery.
static_libs.rclone: rclone contract and screen: remotes, sync and copy jobs with live progress and remote browsing; the pinned static binary runs in the rclone engine.
static_libs.scrollbar: Upstream fast scrollbar, compiled into Cloud Gallery.
static_libs.search: Search scopes and engines driven by the consuming app's build.json::ui.search_scopes.
static_libs.shared-store: cloud-shared-store access: where the fleet store is, and whether this app reaches it directly (shared uid) or through Cloud Terminal (CLOUD_EXEC).
static_libs.shizuku-adb-debug-tools: Self-contained adb shell surface: Shizuku, wireless debugging and the shell channels.
static_libs.sound-tags: Plain-JVM arithmetic of sound identification: WAV decoding, resampling, model windows, label scores.
static_libs.sysdns: The fleet's bridge to Android's resolver for binaries and shells that cannot use it directly.
static_libs.text-tools: Boundary of the Text tools (Enhance, Translate): the ITextTools binder and its client.
static_libs.translate: Translate engine interface and Translator orchestrator (ML-Kit-free).
static_libs.ui-kit: The fleet's shared Compose kit: theme, section header, tiles, cards, settings and confirm rows.
static_libs.updater: The install engine: GHCR client, downloads, PackageInstaller and the update checker.
static_libs.voice: Voice-input module: VoiceBarView, AudioRecord capture and the voice engine interface.
static_libs.wallet: Wallet surface: cards, tickets, calendar and the mail connector.
static_libs.watchdog: The ssh bridge Cloud C3's watchdog uses, shared by reference.
static_libs.webserver: The HTTP serving engine, free of every other fleet dependency.
static_libs.cad-core: The CAD model library core: models.json manifest, format to viewer-lib routing with store-only reasons, sha256-verified model cache and the three.js viewer page.
static_libs.cad-mesh: CAD viewer lib for glTF/GLB, OBJ and FBX (three.js loaders).
static_libs.cad-brep: CAD viewer lib for STEP and IGES (occt-import-js, Open CASCADE in WASM).
static_libs.cad-dxf: CAD viewer lib for DXF drawings (dxf-parser).
static_libs.cad-3dm: CAD viewer lib for Rhino 3DM (rhino3dm.js, WASM).
static_libs.cad-ifc: CAD viewer lib for IFC BIM models (web-ifc, WASM).

lib_apks._doc_exec_native: #705 Modules whose APK must let Android EXTRACT its native libraries at install. AGP keeps every .so stored uncompressed inside the APK and extracts nothing (measured on the published Cloud-Lib-*.apk, 2026-10-01: libgh.so, libgix.so and librclone.so are all stored), which is right for a library loaded with System.loadLibrary and fatal for a BINARY an engine execs: nativeLibraryDir is the one place an app may exec from on API 29+, and with nothing extracted it is empty, so the engine answers 'gh is not installed' from inside the very APK that carries gh. Listed per module, with the reason, because extraction costs every OTHER lib APK install-time disk for nothing; app/build.gradle applies it to exactly these flavors through the variant API (the same packaging.jniLibs.useLegacyPackaging switch cloud-drive sets for its own jniLibs), and a name here that is not a shipped module fails the build. A module whose service execs its own binary and is missing here is refused by test/test-engine-services.sh.

exec_native.gh: #705 GhBackendService execs libgh.so out of this APK's own nativeLibraryDir; Cloud Drive binds that service instead of carrying gh.
exec_native.rclone-engine: #871 RcloneExec execs librclone.so out of this APK's own nativeLibraryDir, in the engine's own uid; Cloud Drive binds that service instead of carrying the 29 MB binary, so the old question (may Drive exec a sibling package's lib?) is never asked.

lib_apks._doc_ids: Flavor applicationId = <application_id_prefix>.<module name with '-' stripped>; release asset = <asset_prefix><Module-Name>.apk. Derived, never listed.
lib_apks._doc_categories: #642 THE ONE DECLARATION of the Libs tab's tables, in render order. An APP is filed by the launcher's central classification (the section+folder its All Apps grid uses), which is why Cloud ▸ Apps has always drawn headed tables. A LIB has no launcher entry, so that classifier returns nothing for it and all 46 rows fell into one unnamed run - the flat list. This supplies the SAME (heading, order) pair from data instead, so StoreCloudFragment groups libs through the mechanism it already had rather than a second one. Members are FLEET ids (lib-<module>, plus the rows regen.sh adds from elsewhere: keyboard-engines, the two rootfs libraries, ae-tool_termux-boot) - the same shape as constellation.groups.members, so the two lists read alike. Ordering is this array's order; within a table it stays A-Z (#334). FIRE RULE #6 still holds: a new module under ../libs still ships an APK and still appears with no edit here - it lands under 'Other' until someone files it. What regen.sh REFUSES is a member id that is not a lib row, because that is a category quietly pointing at a renamed or deleted module. ML libs are not here: ml-{t|l}-{domain}-{name} already names its own tab (#405). #667 FIXED TWO NAMES AND THE REASONING IS THE POINT, because both were about to be tidied back. (1) There was one 'Shell & Input' bucket holding two unrelated kinds. bottomnav/launcher-apptabs/launcher-onehand/launcher-zoomies DRAW - they are Views and Fragments (BottomNavIslandView, AppTabsFragment, ArcMenu, CircularMenu, PetStrengthView), so they are 'ui'. text-tools/translate/voice/keyboard-engines COMPUTE - engines, engine clients and model management (TranslateEngines, Translator, VoiceEngines, VoiceModelManager) - so they are 'language'. Precisely: translate and voice DO each ship one thin bar the keyboard hosts (TranslateBarView, VoiceBarView); that makes them language engines carrying a host-embedded bar, NOT launcher chrome, which is why they moved. (2) 'Runtimes' was wrong twice over. The rootfs libs are complete userlands (~400MB, see the Libs group blurb) that the terminals proot INTO - an OS image, not a language runtime - and the word collides with its own real meaning, because a runtime like nodejs_22 is a thing that lives INSIDE the rootfs and cannot leave it (#664). So the label is OS. ae-tool_termux-boot stays with them because it is the hook that brings that userland up. Do not rename 'os' back to 'runtime'.

android._doc_abi_filters: Mirrors ab_cloud-libs-shared/keyboard-engines. Only ml-l-voice-vosk/ml-l-text-mlkit carry .so payloads; the rest are unaffected by this filter. Add 'x86_64' for Waydroid/emulator and rebuild - no gradle edits needed.
android._doc_packaging_excludes: Duplicate files that must not reach the APK. This repo packages 29 unrelated dependency sets through ONE wrapper module, so license/notice collisions are the normal case rather than an exception: libs:wallet pulls com.sun.mail:android-mail AND android-activation, which both carry META-INF/NOTICE.md, and mergeWalletDebugJavaResource failed the WHOLE build - one flavor taking all 29 APKs down with it. ac_cloud-wallet has carried the same block for its own APK all along. Data, not gradle, so the next collision is a one-line edit here. Never add *.kotlin_module: dropping those breaks Kotlin reflection at runtime, silently. META-INF/versions/*/OSGI-INF/MANIFEST.MF (a glob, every multi-release level): the mwiede jsch fork ships an OSGi manifest under versions/9 AND versions/15, and so do jspecify (9) and bouncycastle via sshj (15) — measured on runs 36068993994 and 36074399160, 2026-09-24. One level at a time was a chase.
android._doc_no_compress: #798 asset extensions every APK keeps STORED: ML Kit's LocalModel memory-maps a bundled .tflite (the image engine's full-label classifier, data/models.json), which a compressed asset cannot be. Applied by app/build.gradle's androidResources.noCompress for every flavor; only the ML engines carry such files.

tests._doc: #705 Read by 1_cicd/dist/scripts/cloud-android-test-engine.sh, which ship-cloud-libs.yml runs before it builds. These testers are the ENGINE side of the app/engine split: once an app binds an engine instead of compiling it, the app's own ship no longer watches the engine's directory, so the only pipeline that runs when an engine changes is this one, and the engine's side of the contract is checked HERE or nowhere.

unit._doc: The engines' JVM suites, run through build.sh test (build.entry below) after the workflow has set up the JDK, the SDK and Gradle. #871 :libs:mounts-engine:testDebugUnitTest runs the mounts engine's JSON surface against a real WebDAV server on loopback (open, list, download, upload, rename, delete), the handle protocol, chunking, the ssh scratch files and the refusals (MountCallsTest), and the protocol clients' pure halves. #871 runs the git sync engine's verbs on real repositories (JGitEngineTest) and its JSON surface, ssh scratch files and chunking (GitCallsTest). #871 :libs:rclone-engine:testDebugUnitTest runs the rclone engine against a fake binary: the argument policy, the caller-owned rclone.conf, the job poll protocol, the chunked listing, the cancel and the two refusals. #881 :libs:decisions-core:test runs the decisions engine's policy, redaction, spend ledger, cache, breaker, consent and orchestration suites and PIT-gates them at 80; :libs:decisions-engine:testDebugUnitTest pins the service's wire, its caller identity and its file stores; :libs:decisions-link:testDebugUnitTest pins the client's parse and that no credential is in the wire. #871 :libs:ops-engine:testDebugUnitTest pins the ops engine's parse of both Dagu payload shapes and its https-and-own-host-only refusal. #871 :libs:analytics-sink:testDebugUnitTest pins the sink engine's Umami and Matomo wire formats byte for byte and its https-and-own-hosts-only refusal. :libs:gh's GhLoginTest runs the gh engine's real sign-in job against a fake gh that prints the one-time code and then blocks, and fails unless the code reaches the job while gh is still waiting; it also runs libs:sysdns's ResolverProxy, the loopback tunnel gh needs to resolve names inside an app. #741 :libs:sysdns's own SysDnsTest runs the terminals' DNS bridge against a fake resolver (the client's id comes back, a failed lookup is a SERVFAIL glibc accepts, an oversized UDP answer is truncated there and whole over TCP) and the proxy in the any-host mode rclone and gix use. The phone once showed a DNS failure for a sign-in that never reached GitHub, and no shell tester can execute either property. #798 :libs:ml-l-sound-yamnet's ClassifierTest replays the real YAMNet's scores for a golden clip through the engine's whole pipeline and reads the label list out of the real, sha-verified model file; :libs:ml-l-image-mlkit's DetectorTest does the same for the classifier object detection names boxes with; :libs:sound-tags runs PIT (gate 80). Cloud Mesh fallbacks: :libs:net-wg's MeshRelayTest runs the engine's TCP/443 relay (MeshRelay, WsTunnel) against a local server speaking the fleet wstunnel v11 wire: the upgrade at /<prefix>/events with the UDP ticket, a wrong key answered 400 and named, a server ping answered, datagrams of every frame-length class round-tripping, unmasked frames (the fleet server does not unmask). One task per engine that has a suite, space-separated.

build._doc: Read by cloud-android-test-engine.sh's unit phase only: this repo has no gradlew, and build.sh test is the invocation that fetches the pinned firestack aar first, as every gradle run here does.

modules._doc: Only the wrapper lives here. The :libs:* modules are appended by settings.gradle from the lib_apks scan above, each pointing at the one canonical directory in ab_cloud-libs-shared/libs/.

signing._doc: ONE shared Cloud-constellation signing key for ALL Android apps. build.sh::_resolve_signing resolves $VAULT_DIR + sops-decrypts the passwords. NO fallback.

release._doc_kind: 'lib' = a companion APK that ships engines/behaviour rather than UI. data/regen.sh files these under the SuperApp Constellation page's Libs tab instead of Apps. This repo produces MANY of them, so regen.sh expands lib_apks into one fleet entry per module.
release._doc_auto_update: libs:updater is itself one of the shipped modules and reads release.auto_update from the CONSUMING repo. Disabled here on purpose: each library APK has its own GHCR image, while the updater carries a single image name, so a self-update would pull the wrong artifact. Library APKs are updated by the SuperApp's Constellation page (Libs tab), which knows each one's asset.

auto_update._doc_max_installs_per_pass: Most install sessions ONE unattended background pass may open. A background pass cannot show the system install dialog (Android 10+ blocks background activity starts), so each install it starts leaves a tap-to-install notification holding a PackageInstaller session until the user answers it. Unbounded, one pass over the 40-entry fleet opens 40 and the installer hits Android's 50-session cap - 'Too many active sessions for UID'. The remainder is picked up by the next pass. User-initiated 'Update all' is NOT capped: it runs in the foreground where the dialog appears and sessions resolve at once.

ghcr._doc_image: Per-module image name is '<image_prefix><module>' - that is what build.sh pushes. `image` is the repo-level fallback that libs:updater's BuildConfig reads; it is never pushed to, because a library APK does not self-update (see auto_update below).
ghcr._doc: DISABLED for the same reason ac_cloud-watchdog disabled it, and it is the fix rather than a workaround. A GHCR package is owned by the ACCOUNT, not the repository: GitHub creates every new user-owned package PRIVATE whatever repo pushed it, image.source only LINKS it, and no API can change it (PATCH /user/packages/... 404s even with write:packages). Measured: cloud-watchdog was deleted and rebuilt by GITHUB_TOKEN from inside this PUBLIC repo's own workflow and came back private. One APK per library module means one package per module, so this flow multiplies the problem: cloud-lib-watchdog 403'd and cloud-lib-search was private too. A channel that cannot follow repo visibility is one these APKs do not ship on; the GH Release asset IS the repo and follows it by construction. Re-enable only under an ORG namespace, where PATCH /orgs/{org}/packages/.../visibility exists.

analytics._doc: Consumed by :libs:analytics, which reads THIS file (rootDir) at build time and bakes the values into BuildConfig. Both backends are single-site today, so every app reports into the same site and is told apart by .app — give each app its own site_id once per-app sites exist in Umami/Matomo.
